name: veritygrid
description: Enterprise Data Trust, Intelligence & Reliability Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @veritygrid/api" "npm run dev -w @veritygrid/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @veritygrid/api && npm run build -w @veritygrid/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veritygrid/api && npm run typecheck -w @veritygrid/web
